faq_connect: How do I connect my WooCommerce store?
faq_connect_a: Go to Settings → Integrations and enter your store URL along with the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret from WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
faq_credits_a: Each AI action uses credits: SEO text generation costs 5 credits, section regeneration costs 2 credits, and image generation costs 2-4 credits depending on the style.
faq_sync: Why doesn't sync bring all products?
faq_sync_a: Check if the WooCommerce API key has Read permissions. If using Cloudflare, make sure our IPs are not blocked. You can retry the sync from the Products page.
faq_image: How long does AI image generation take?
faq_image_a: Usually 20-60 seconds per image, depending on the chosen style. "White Background" images are the fastest.

faq_publish_q: How do I publish products back to WooCommerce?
faq_publish_a: From a product's SEO page, after saving the content, click "Publish to store". The product will be updated directly in WooCommerce.
faq_cms_q: Can I use Hontrio with another CMS?
faq_cms_a: Currently we only support WooCommerce. Shopify and other platforms are on the roadmap.
